latestVersion.changelog: Least-privilege maintenance: the script now reads TAVILY_API_KEY only from the host environment, no longer opens OpenClaw credential files, and CI uses current Node 24-based actions.

raw_record.summary: Search the public web through Tavily and return structured results with URLs and snippets. Use when an agent needs current information, source discovery, link lookup, news or finance search, or a fallback for unavailable built-in web search. Do not use for private or authenticated pages.
